description: Kliqo's recommended actions for the project (suggested automatically from the data, or added by the team), most important first: what to do, why, the steps, the page to change and the expected impact. Pass action_id for one action's details and evidence. Use for "what should we do to show up in ChatGPT?" or when planning work; in a code editor, an action's steps can be applied to the site. Needs sign-in to Kliqo (read-only).

project.description: Project name, domain or id; leave out for the workspace's current project

status.description: open = suggested, to do and in progress
